dialogues.speaker: Khaldun
dialogues.text: Studying ancient history through linguistics and semiotics is tunnel-visioning. It's impossible to draw any meaningful conclusions from it.

dialogues.speaker: Khaldun
dialogues.text: This is where you Haravatat would make mistakes. See Faruzan.

dialogues.speaker: Yavanani
dialogues.text: Your sociological approach to history would be putting the cart before the horse.

dialogues.speaker: Yavanani
dialogues.text: It is meaningless to try to find some universal rules and norms that can explain all events throughout history.

dialogues.speaker: Yavanani
dialogues.text: As for Faruzan, her points are out of date. Can't even be used as a reference.
